## Our Story {.mb-2}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

Allied was founded on a simple idea: construction projects work better when the people managing your cranes, logistics, and scaffolding are working as one team — not three separate suppliers pointing fingers at each other.

Starting with Allied Lifting, we built a reputation for safety, reliability, and competence across London's most demanding residential and commercial projects. Working with clients like Wates, we saw first-hand how fragmented on-site services create delays, communication gaps, and unnecessary cost.

So we expanded. Allied Logistics brings technology-enabled construction logistics coordination. Allied Scaffolding completes the picture. Together, they form Allied Group — an integrated platform for on-site construction services.

::::::
:::::: {.col-lg-6}

::: {.pillar-card .mb-3}
**London-based** projects across residential, commercial, student accommodation, care homes, and major infrastructure.
:::

::: {.pillar-card .mb-3}
**Tier one clients** including Wates Construction, Wates Residential, Paradigm, and major London developers.
:::

::: {.pillar-card}
**Integrated operations** — the only provider offering crane, logistics, and scaffolding under unified management.
:::

## Our Values {.text-center .mb-2}

::: {.gold-line-center}
:::

::::: {.row .g-4 .mt-3}

[**Safety**]{.value-icon}

#### Safety
Tier one standards on every site. HSE best practice, competent operatives, continuous training, and our shadow man programme ensure no corners are cut.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.value-card}
[**Integration**]{.value-icon}

#### Integration
One team managing crane, logistics, and scaffolding. Single accountability eliminates the coordination gaps that cause delays.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.value-card}
[**Technology**]{.value-icon}

#### Technology
Real-time dashboards, KPI tracking, 4D planning, and delivery management systems. Visibility that traditional operators cannot match.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.value-card}
[**Sustainability**]{.value-icon}

#### Sustainability
Net Zero 2030 commitment. 60%+ carbon reduction through route optimisation and intelligent coordination.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.value-card}
[**Transparency**]{.value-icon}

#### Transparency
KPI-based contracts with penalties for non-performance. We share the data openly because we stand behind our results.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.value-card}
[**Flexibility**]{.value-icon}

#### Flexibility
Asset-light model means project-specific solutions. We adapt to your project, not the other way around.
